notes: All 39 source and 55 target tokens are partitioned exactly once, with one `added` unit.
s001 הֲ is `unrepresented` because the ASV marks the first question by inversion alone, while s008 אִם takes the fronted *will* — the asymmetry is read off the ASV rather than imposed.

The concessive *though* at t035 is `added`: the waw of וַיִּתְגָּעֲשׁוּ already has the *and* written for it, so rule 55 applies and the subordinator may not be folded into the waw. The second colon's waw is a different case, being the only connective written for it.

*cannot* is kept undivided on the negative, following rule 48's ruling on the same fused word; מִפָּנַי is split because the ASV spends a word on each morpheme, so rule 30's one-rendering condition is unmet.
The ASV footnote 'Or, an everlasting ordinance which it cannot pass' offers an alternative construal of s021–s025 and does not change the alignment of the text as printed.
